notes: A124000_char (A124000_mathlib.lean): a semiprime C(n,k) with 2 <= k <= n-2 is 35 or p(2p+-1) with p, 2p+-1 prime, and conversely; A124000_odd, A124000_triangular give both conjectures. Route: prime factors of C(n,k) are <= n (Nat.pow_factorization_choose_le) so a semiprime C(n,k) <= n^2 < C(n,3) for n >= 9; n <= 8 by cases; k = 2 by coprime factors m, 2m+-1. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
